overview.description: The Aristotle Multi-Sector Income ETF (ARMS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF investing in USD-denominated income-producing debt instruments. The fund invests in both corporate and government securities that have weighted average duration within zero to eight years. ARMS was launched on Jul 29, 2026 and is issued by Aristotle.
